Making language & speech systems

I’m an M.Sc. student in Computer Science at UBC, advised by Vered Shwartz and Hila Gonen in the Natural Language Processing Lab. I enjoy open-ended problems and elegant solutions at the intersection of utility, reliability, and efficiency.

01 / Research

Better systems.
Deeper understanding.

01

Reliable reasoning

When should a model challenge a question’s assumptions? I study false presuppositions in question answering and the tradeoff between correcting false assumptions and answering valid questions.

Question answering · Robustness
02

Learning in context

I investigate how transformer, state-space, and hybrid models learn from context, using behavioral probing and interventions to understand the roles of retrieval and contextual understanding.

Interpretability · Model architectures
03

Speech with less

I explore efficient multilingual speech synthesis and voice anonymization for low-resource languages, with attention to speaker privacy and Indigenous language education.

Speech synthesis · Low-resource learning
